root_idea.summary: A state of perplexity or loss of direction, with the related idea of a place in which a person loses the way.
root_idea.development: The root denotes bewilderment and disorientation; the same semantic orientation extends to the trackless desert where one becomes lost. The supplied evidence does not independently establish a fuller form-level Quranic definition beyond the contextual rendering of the attested occurrence.
